cases.court: U.S. District Court, S.D. New York

products.name: Udio
products.note: AI music generation; copyright risk; likeness in vocals; RIAA litigation context

profile_text.body:
Udio is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in New York, NY, that operates an AI music generation platform at udio.com. The company describes itself as a service that lets users discover, create, and share music using what it calls the latest technology to generate AI music in seconds. Its core product, also named Udio, falls in the voice and audio category and is oriented toward rapid, text-prompted music creation.

Udio is a defendant in UMG Recordings v. Uncharted Labs, Inc. (Udio), filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, which places it among the sites tracked for legal exposure in New York. The held facts note copyright risk, vocal likeness concerns, and an RIAA litigation context in connection with the Udio product, reflecting the broader legal scrutiny that AI music generation tools have attracted from the recorded music industry.
